name: Interval Join
description: Joins each record of the first input to the intervals in the second input that contain its value (a number or a date between a start and an end), optionally only where another field matches as well.
introductoryText:
Joins each record of the first input to every interval of the second input that contains its value: a parcel weight to its price band, an order date to the price period in force, a score to its grade.

**How to set it up**

- **Value in interval**: the number or date field of the first input.
- **Interval start** and **Interval end**: the fields of the second input that bound each interval, of the same kind (numbers or dates). An empty start means no lower limit, an empty end no upper limit.
- **Start** and **End**: whether a value equal to the start or the end is inside the interval. The defaults (start inclusive, end exclusive) suit bands that follow on from each other, such as 0 to 2 and 2 to 5.
- **Join type**: Inner keeps only records that fall in an interval; Left keeps every record of the first input, with empty interval fields where none contains it.
- **Also match on** (optional): a field in each input that must be equal too, for example the delivery zone, so each zone uses its own bands.

A record in several overlapping intervals is output once for each. The output has the first input's fields, then the second's; a field name in both gets `.1` on the second input's copy.

options.name: join_type
options.title: Join type
options.description: Inner: only records whose value is in an interval. Left: every record of the first input; those in no interval have empty fields from the second input.

choices.title: Inner
choices.description: Only records whose value falls in an interval

choices.title: Left
choices.description: Every record of the first input

options.name: value
options.title: Value in interval (first input)
options.description: The number or date field of the first input to look up in the intervals.

options.name: start
options.title: Interval start (second input)
options.description: The field of the second input where each interval starts (number or date, the same kind as the value). Empty means no lower limit.

options.name: end
options.title: Interval end (second input)
options.description: The field of the second input where each interval ends (number or date). Empty means no upper limit.

options.name: start_comparator
options.title: Start
options.description: Whether a value equal to the interval's start is inside it. Inclusive: a value of 5 is in the interval 5 to 10. Exclusive: it is not.

options.name: end_comparator
options.title: End
options.description: Whether a value equal to the interval's end is inside it. Inclusive: a value of 10 is in the interval 5 to 10. Exclusive: it is not, so bands such as 5 to 10 and 10 to 20 do not overlap.

options.name: left
options.title: Field in first input
options.description: A field that must also be equal, for example a zone or product code. Choose it in both inputs, or leave both empty.

options.name: right
options.title: Field in second input
options.description: The field of the second input to compare with the first input's field.

blockOutputs.label: Joined
blockOutputs.tooltip: Each first-input record once per interval that contains its value: its fields, then the interval's fields (a name in both gets .1). Left join: records in no interval are kept with empty interval fields.
